description: Go client for the Ozon Seller API covering 263 API endpoints across 22 service modules with 1180 generated types: products, FBO/FBS orders, prices, stocks, warehouses, finance, reviews.
rules: Use context.Context for all API calls
Handle *transport.APIError for non-2xx responses via errors.As
Construct services with ozon.NewClient(clientID, apiKey, nil)
